title: PowerShell Download Via Net.WebClient - PowerShell Classic
description:
Detects PowerShell download activity, via the .DownloadFile() or .DownloadString() methods of the Net.WebClient class.
This technique is often abused by attackers to download additional payloads.
author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
falsepositives: This activity may be used by legitimate software, such as patch management tools or software updaters. Investigate any such activity and apply the necessary filter.

description: |
    Detects PowerShell download activity, via the .DownloadFile() or .DownloadString() methods of the Net.WebClient class.
    This technique is often abused by attackers to download additional payloads.

detection:
    selection_webclient:
        Data|contains: 'Net.WebClient'
    selection_download:
        Data|contains:
            - '.DownloadFile('
            - '.DownloadString('
    condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:

level: low
